name: workshop-design
description: "Assess an existing sample app and design or revamp an advanced hands-on workshop with fresh first-party research, measurable learning goals, timing and three audiences. Use for workshop planning, app selection, feature scope and curriculum design."
---
# App-first workshop design

1. Load workshop-resources and use its redacted root registry summary. Resolve paths relative to the working repository and inspect local instructions before action. If this is a new app rather than enhancing an existing one, use the required project-planning workflow for that platform.
2. Read the app README, dependency manifest, calculator/domain logic, server/UI boundaries, existing enhancement specs and tests. Run the smallest baseline commands; record actual results. Identify the one realistic feature that teaches the requested skills without unrelated complexity.
3. Preserve original behavior. State simulation assumptions (token heuristics, cached input fraction, reasoning overhead, retained visible output vs hidden thinking) separately from published product facts. Never guess model prices or invent supported fields.
4. Collect current official GitHub/VS Code documentation for the requested concepts: agent surfaces/harnesses, skills/custom agents/subagents, permissions/modes, worktrees and cloud isolation, hooks, orchestration and cost. Cite URLs and verification dates; preview and uncertainty labels travel into deck, labs and narration. Do not mistake remembered research for fresh verification.
5. Map each objective to a concrete learner action and observable pass/fail evidence. Prefer the actual existing app over a second sample; choose useful small setup tasks, a reusable skill, an agent team and a parallel integration capstone.
6. Default to 180 minutes: welcome 5 + continuous presentation 45 + labs 20/25/30/40 (recaps included) + break 10 + close 5. Calculate the sum. If changing any slot, update every agenda, guide, deck, narration and recap length.
7. Define distinct lesson, student and instructor outputs. Instructor coaching is not a copy of student steps; a lesson video must explain the concepts, not only announce labs. Keep language accessible while teaching advanced contracts, ownership and context discipline.
8. Create approved requirements and lane briefs in the deliverables themselves or session notes; do not add unrelated tracking/planning markdown files. Coordinate independent research, code and production lanes without shared-file writes.

Current repo architecture and history: [workflow reference](./references/current-workshop.md). Next load workshop-labs BEFORE enhancing the app; then workshop-media and workshop-verify.
